metadata.description: Real 4 x 4 km study area in the rural hills of Uljin-gun, Gyeongsangbuk-do, on the eastern Korean coast: Copernicus DEM GLO-30 terrain and OpenStreetMap roads. Chosen because Uljin is genuine Korean wildfire country (the March 2022 Uljin-Samcheok fire burned this region) and because both sources have verified coverage here.
metadata.notes: The terrain is a DIGITAL SURFACE MODEL: GLO-30 includes canopy and buildings, so slope over forest here is canopy slope, not ground slope (docs/FAILURE_MODES.md F-TER-3). OSM rural completeness is UNKNOWN, so the road network is a lower bound on what exists on the ground, and the egress counts derived from it inherit that limitation.
